Stage 5 · Java foundations

Encapsulation: Vault + ATM

Private fields, validating methods. One guard protects all callers.

⏱ 14 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Locked cap, measured spoon

Rules live in ONE place.

💊

Child-proof bottle. Locked cap (private) + measured spoon (public method). Handfuls impossible; safe doses easy. Clumsy spoons make users pry — design lovingly.

ProgramRead each line in order
class Book {
  private int pages; // hidden vault
  public int getPages() { return pages; }
  public void setPages(int p) {
    if (p <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("pages must be > 0");
    pages = p;
  }
}
Book b = new Book();
b.setPages(-5);  // rejected loudly
b.setPages(200); // accepted
b.getPages();    // 200

One doorway, guarded. −5 detonates, 200 stores.

setPages(−5)
REJECTED
Loud error
setPages(200)
Stored
Valid
getPages()
200
Reported
Read-only = getter with NO setter. Never leak live mutable lists!
